content: This project's shadcn/ui style is 'base-nova', built on @base-ui/react (not Radix, not cmdk). shadcn's official base-nova registry ships a 'combobox' component (https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/base-nova/combobox.json) built directly on @base-ui/react's own Combobox primitive — not cmdk. @base-ui/react is already installed at ^1.6.0 (matches npm latest 1.6.0), so adding the combobox is a  copy-paste (pulls in registryDependencies button + input-group, both zero-cost file copies), not a new npm dependency.
